chapterTitle: Principle 7: Retention: Don't fill a leaky bucket

support.text: Principle 7: Retention: Don't fill a leaky bucket
Retention deals with avoiding fast forgetting.

safeExtensions: Learning can decay after acquisition if it is never revisited.
Important gains may need return visits over time.
One-time success does not guarantee durable hold.
prohibitedDrift: claims that every item deserves equal review forever
